title: Bitcoin Q&A: How Do I Secure My Bitcoin?
summary: Andreas Antonopoulos answers a question about how to secure your Bitcoin. He covers holding your own keys, backing up the 12 to 24 word seed phrase, and the tradeoffs of custodial accounts, phone wallets and hardware wallets.
why: HN recommends it as a clear explanation of self-custody and of why to move coins off exchanges.

quote.text: Here's a talk by the venerable Andreas Antonopoulos on this subject
